admin.repRules.moodDescription: Adjust how the "Happiness" stat shown in "Stats" is modulated by the player's context (weather, today's encounters, familiar, wallet, fights won, regular feeding). Never changes the stored raw value, only the display — except the non-feeding penalty, applied once per missed day directly to Happiness/XP/Hunger/Wallet.
admin.repRules.moodEncounterBonusMax: 👥 Max bonus when the daily goal is reached
admin.repRules.moodFamiliarBonus: 🐉 Bonus if at least one familiar is tamed
admin.repRules.moodWalletThreshold: 💰 Wallet — reference amount for the full bonus
admin.repRules.moodFeedBonusMax: 🍖 Happiness bonus if the daily goal is reached
admin.repRules.moodFeedHappinessPenalty: 🍖 Happiness removed per missed day (goal not reached)
admin.repRules.moodFeedWalletPenalty: 🍖 Wallet coins removed per missed day
admin.repRules.mapDescription: Settings for map discovery and travel to worlds (on foot vs by vehicle) — see the "World Map" widget window.
admin.repRules.mapPoiDiscoveryXp: 🧭 XP gained discovering a point of interest while exploring
admin.repRules.travelWalkDurationSec: 🥾 Simulated duration of a journey on foot (seconds)
admin.repRules.travelNightEncounterChanc: 🌙 % chance of a hostile night encounter while traveling on foot
admin.repRules.travelNightMonsterDamage: 💥 Damage (HP) if the night encounter is lost
admin.repRules.hutDescription: Voluntary hut rest settings (isometric 2D platform widget) — click a hut adjacent to Synk.
admin.repRules.hutRestHp: ❤️ HP restored by a hut rest
admin.repRules.hutRestCooldownHours: ⏳ Minimum delay between two hut rests (hours)
admin.repRules.sleepDescription: Settings for the automatic rest triggered when Synk's Health drops too low (SleepModal.tsx) — locks the interface while regaining strength.
admin.repRules.sleepGraceSec: ⏳ Grace period after waking before it can trigger again (seconds)
admin.repRules.oxygenDescription: Settings for the oxygen mechanic when Synk walks on water or mountain/rock tiles (isometric 2D platform widget) — drain, penalties, fainting from drowning/altitude, and recovery on solid ground.
admin.repRules.oxygenPenaltyXp: ✨ XP lost per interval spent on water/mountain
admin.repRules.oxygenPenaltyForce: 💪 Force lost per interval spent on water/mountain
admin.repRules.oxygenRecoveryIntervalSec: ⏱️ Oxygen recovery interval on solid ground (seconds)
admin.repRules.oxygenRecoveryPct: 🌿 % oxygen regained per interval on solid ground
admin.repRules.fatigueDescription: Settings for the Fatigue mechanic triggered by Synk's continuous movement (2D isometric platform or World Map) — drains while moving, recovers while stopped/slowed.
admin.repRules.fatigueDrainPct: 🥵 % Fatigue lost per interval while moving
admin.repRules.fatigueStopGraceSec: ⏳ Delay without movement before considering Synk stopped/slowed (seconds)
admin.repRules.fatigueRecoveryPct: 💤 % Fatigue regained per interval while stopped
admin.repRules.fatigueLowStatsDescriptio: Synk tires a bit faster while moving when his HP, Hunger, Force or Oxygen are low — capped penalty to always stay reasonable.
admin.repRules.fatigueLowStatsThresholdP: 📉 Threshold (%) below which a stat counts as "low"
admin.repRules.fatigueLowStatsExtraDrain: 🥵 Extra % Fatigue lost per low stat
admin.repRules.fatigueLowStatsMaxExtraPc: 🛡️ Cap on the total of this penalty
admin.repRules.fatigueFaintDescription: When Fatigue drops below the threshold below, Synk faints from exhaustion: interface blocked until Fatigue recovers 100%, with immediate HP loss.
admin.repRules.fatigueFaintResultPopupEn: Show the loss info popup on waking up
admin.repRules.altitudeDescription: Above a certain altitude, Oxygen and Fatigue drain faster (mountains up to 6000 m). A peak can stay snow-capped year-round, independently of the season.
admin.repRules.altitudeSnowThresholdM: Altitude above which a peak is snow-capped year-round (m)
admin.repRules.altitudeRarefactionStartM: Altitude above which air starts to rarefy (m)
admin.repRules.altitudeRarefactionMinInt: Minimum interval factor at the peak (0.05-1, lower = faster)
admin.repRules.waterDepthDescription: The deeper a water tile is (sea/ocean), the faster Oxygen drains — same principle as altitude.
admin.repRules.waterDepthRarefactionMinI: Minimum interval factor at maximum depth (0.05-1)
admin.repRules.islandDescription: Stepping onto an island tile requires a Vehicle (raft, kayak, boat, hot air balloon…) in the bag.
admin.repRules.islandVehicleRequired: Require a Vehicle in the bag to access islands
admin.repRules.movementDescription: A short tap (keyboard, virtual D-pad or mouse) moves Synk exactly 1 cell. Holding a direction starts walking at the pace below, then switches to running after the configured hold threshold.
admin.repRules.poiObstacleCollisionEnabl: Block keyboard/D-pad movement into an obstacle POI (huts, villages, tavern, stable) — click-to-approach stays unchanged
admin.repRules.platform3dRefinementsDesc: Fine-grained 3D Platform settings, independent from its global toggle (Custom Widgets section).
admin.repRules.platform3dEquipmentRender: Show Synk's equipment (weapon, shield, helmet, amulet, etc.) on the 3D model
admin.repRules.platform3dJumpEnabled: Enable jump (space bar) to climb mountains/rocks
admin.repRules.platform3dResizableEnable: Allow resizing (up to full screen) of the 3D widget
admin.repRules.platform3dCameraRelativeM: Camera-relative movement ("Up" = move away from the camera, even after orbiting it with the mouse) — otherwise fixed world direction (north/south/east/west)
admin.repRules.platform3dChaseCameraEnab: Automatic chase camera: as soon as Synk walks, the camera resets behind him (seen from behind) even if the player has re-orbited the view — disable to always allow free orbiting
admin.repRules.platform3dClimbDescriptio: Climbing (hold Space) onto a tile higher than Synk can, depending on the height difference crossed in one go (converted to "cubes"), inflict minor damage or even a fatal fall. Descending is always free and damage-free.
admin.repRules.platform3dFallDamageMinCu: Minor damage threshold (cubes of height diff.)
admin.repRules.platform3dFallDeathCubes: Fatal fall threshold (cubes of height diff.)
admin.repRules.platform3dFallDeathRevive: Fatal fall — popup duration before revive (s)
admin.repRules.platform3dObjectFlagsDesc: Defines, for each terrain/prop type, whether it blocks movement (obstacle), can be climbed (climbable), or submerges Synk (water) — freely editable without touching the code.
admin.repRules.platform3dUnderwaterDescr: Right-click on a water tile: offers to swim at the surface (default) or dive fully into a decorative underwater world (fish, sea creatures).
admin.repRules.platform3dUnderwaterWorld: Enable the right-click "Dive" menu and the underwater world
admin.repRules.platform3dUnderwaterMoveE: Allow Synk to swim/move while fully submerged (arrow keys/D-pad)
admin.repRules.platform3dUnderwaterMoveR: Bounded exploration radius while fully submerged (3D units)
admin.repRules.defaultLakesEnabled: Show the 10 default lakes/ponds on the world map
admin.repRules.synkLimbAnimationDescript: Animates Synk's legs/arms/torso/head (subtle walk sway) across the 8 directions (cardinal + diagonal) in the isometric Platform. Disabling reverts to the original static rendering.
admin.repRules.depthAltitudePopupDescrip: Small non-blocking, blinking indicator shown while Synk stands on a water tile (depth) or a mountain/rock tile (altitude), in the isometric Platform and the World Map. Purely informational.
admin.repRules.kingdomDescription: The 400 Kingdom Quests form the main storyline (freeing PocaPoka and El Pipo from Zorghon). They unlock one by one, in order, once the condition below is met; 40 of them only appear on a full moon night (see the "Full moon" panel above).
admin.repRules.kingdomMinIntermediateSol: 🗝️ Number of intermediate quests (classic + NPC) to solve to unlock the 1st Kingdom Quest
admin.repRules.zorghonDescription: Once enough Kingdom Quests are solved, Zorghon the Vile and his captives PocaPoka & El Pipo appear on the map (islands included). Getting too close to Zorghon gives him a chance to relocate his captives elsewhere; reaching their position frees them and grants XP.
admin.repRules.zorghonAppearKingdomSolve: 👑 Number of Kingdom Quests solved before Zorghon appears
admin.repRules.zorghonProximityPct: 📏 Distance (%) below which Zorghon senses Synk approaching
admin.repRules.zorghonRelocationChancePc: 🎲 Probability (%) of relocating captives on each check
admin.repRules.zorghonRescueXpReward: ✨ XP awarded when PocaPoka and El Pipo are freed
admin.repRules.onboardingDescription: Playful welcome screens explaining the game's context, quests and features (see also the floating "Help" widget, always available and reusing the same content).
admin.repRules.onboardingEnabled: Automatically show the guided tour on first visit

admin.customWidgets.onchainFeed.title: Synk on-chain feeding (Sepolia) — disabled by default
admin.customWidgets.onchainFeed.descript: The currently deployed Sepolia contract has a known bug where the 4 feed cooldowns (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) are wrongly shared: feeding Synk with one can incorrectly block the others. The fix is already written in code (`lastFedAtByType`) but requires a contract redeploy to take effect (see ROADMAP.md). Meanwhile these 4 buttons are hidden in-game; players can feed/heal Synk via the Shop instead. Only re-enable if you accept this temporary bug.
admin.customWidgets.onchainFeed.toggle: Allow the 4 on-chain feed buttons despite the known bug

admin.customWidgets.hint: 💡 100% off-chain. Buttons only run predefined, safe actions (link, message, player effect) — no arbitrary code.

quest.npc_riddle_01: 🌀 NPC Riddle 1: I am a ring of stone covered in symbols, able to link two worlds in an instant. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_02: 🕳️ NPC Riddle 2: I bend space-time to link two distant points in the universe without crossing the distance between them. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_03: 🌲 NPC Riddle 3: I live in a cozy hole, love six meals a day, and hate adventures... until offered one. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_04: 🧌 NPC Riddle 4: I live under bridges, regenerate my wounds except against fire, and jealously guard my passage. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_05: 🧙 NPC Riddle 5: Without a wand or staff I am nothing, but with a spellbook I shape the elements. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_06: ⚒️ NPC Riddle 6: Small like a sprite, a blacksmith at heart, I tinker with mechanisms underground. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_07: 🐲 NPC Riddle 7: I breathe devastating flames and sit atop a burning hoard in my volcanic lair. What is my colour?
quest.npc_riddle_08: 🐉 NPC Riddle 8: I am the noblest and wisest of the metallic dragons, guardian of justice. What precious metal bears my name?
quest.npc_riddle_09: ⚔️ NPC Riddle 9: I was pulled from a stone or handed over by a Lady of the Lake; only a rightful king can wield me. What is my name?
quest.npc_riddle_10: 🛡️ NPC Riddle 10: I bear the cross on my breastplate, protect pilgrims, and guard ancient secrets beneath my temple. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_11: 🏰 NPC Riddle 11: Built by Daedalus to imprison a half-man half-bull monster, I have only one entrance but a thousand paths. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_12: 🐮 NPC Riddle 12: Half man, half bull, I haunt the heart of a Cretan labyrinth. Who am I?
quest.npc_riddle_13: 🌸 NPC Riddle 13: I melt the snow, bloom the flowers, and revive nature after winter. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_14: ☀️ NPC Riddle 14: I bring the longest days and the highest sun of the year. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_15: 🍂 NPC Riddle 15: I paint the leaves orange and red before they fall. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_16: ❄️ NPC Riddle 16: I cover the world in white and freeze rivers under ice. Which season am I?
quest.npc_riddle_17: 🔮 NPC Riddle 17: Without me, no wizard could heal wounds instantly with a single sip. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_18: 📜 NPC Riddle 18: An engraved symbol carrying magical power, I seal secret passages and ancient spells. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_19: 🌍 NPC Riddle 19: I link Azeroth to Draenor, opened by the Orcs of the Horde to invade a new world. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_20: 🔺 NPC Riddle 20: Made of three golden triangles, I represent Power, Wisdom, and Courage united. What am I?
quest.npc_riddle_01.hint: You dial a 7-symbol address before activating it.
quest.npc_riddle_02.hint: Einstein and Rosen gave me my other name: the Einstein-Rosen bridge.
quest.npc_riddle_03.hint: My feet are hairy and I stand under four feet tall.
quest.npc_riddle_04.hint: Only fire or acid stops me from regenerating.
quest.npc_riddle_05.hint: I often wear a pointed hat and a long beard.
quest.npc_riddle_06.hint: I'm cousin to the dwarf, but I prefer gears to pickaxes.
quest.npc_riddle_07.hint: My colour evokes lava and rage.
quest.npc_riddle_08.hint: I'm also shaped into crowns and precious coins.
quest.npc_riddle_09.hint: A hand rising from a lake sometimes holds me above the surface.
quest.npc_riddle_10.hint: My order was founded to protect the road to Jerusalem.
quest.npc_riddle_11.hint: A thread of Ariadne lets you find your way out.
quest.npc_riddle_12.hint: Theseus defeated me thanks to a thread.
quest.npc_riddle_14.hint: The solstice bearing my name is the longest day of the year.
quest.npc_riddle_15.hint: Harvests end before I give way to winter.
quest.npc_riddle_16.hint: The solstice bearing my name is the longest night of the year.
quest.npc_riddle_17.hint: You drink me in one gulp, often from a glass vial.
quest.npc_riddle_18.hint: I'm sometimes traced on a door or a scroll to activate it.
quest.npc_riddle_19.hint: It was first opened by Ner'zhul.
quest.npc_riddle_20.hint: It belongs to the goddess Hylia and her three legendary bearers.

onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to the Lands of ZeldCraft
onboarding.step1.intro: Discover the world of Horizon ZeldCraft before setting off on an adventure with Synk!
onboarding.topic.world.title: The world of ZeldCraft
onboarding.topic.world.body: Synk is your faithful companion. Together, you explore the lands, seas and mountains of ZeldCraft, a realm rich in secrets, dangers… and friendships.
onboarding.topic.zorghon.title: Zorghon the Malevolent
onboarding.topic.zorghon.body: The sorcerer Zorghon has kidnapped Princess PocaPoka and her loyal sand sprite El Pipo. Your ultimate quest: track him down, defeat him and free them.
onboarding.topic.fragments.title: The 5 Fragments of the Runic Seal
onboarding.topic.fragments.body: Scattered across the world (quest relics, never lost even when fainting), these fragments must all be reunited to unlock the final quest of Chapter 40.
onboarding.topic.chapters.title: 40 chapters, 400 Kingdom Quests
onboarding.topic.chapters.body: The main storyline is made of 40 chapters of 10 riddles each. They unlock progressively as you advance, all the way to Zorghon.
onboarding.topic.npcs.title: Encounters & NPCs
onboarding.topic.npcs.body: Knights, wizards, hobbits, island natives… Many NPCs will offer you intermediate quests, hints and treasures along the way.
onboarding.topic.worldsToExplore.title: Worlds to discover
onboarding.topic.worldsToExplore.body: The World Map spans lands, mountains, seas, oceans, islands and archipelagos. Explore it to expand your territory and make new encounters.
onboarding.step2.title: Quests, dangers & kingdom life
onboarding.step2.intro: Understand how to progress through the adventure… and the risks that await you.
onboarding.topic.questTypes.title: Classic, NPC & Kingdom quests
onboarding.topic.questTypes.body: Classic and NPC quests (intermediate quests) can be solved freely. As they add up, they unlock the 400 Kingdom Quests one by one, leading to Zorghon.
onboarding.topic.fullMoon.title: Full moon quests
onboarding.topic.fullMoon.body: Some Kingdom Quests only appear on a full moon day (real calendar, shown in-game). Come back that day so you don't miss them!
onboarding.topic.islandQuests.title: Archipelago & wild island quests
onboarding.topic.islandQuests.body: Hop on a raft, canoe or ship (earned or purchased) to reach the islands and their brand-new intermediate quests.
onboarding.topic.fainting.title: Watch out for fainting!
onboarding.topic.fainting.body: Oxygen or Fatigue running out = Synk faints: he loses hit points, experience and a random item from his bag (quest relics are always protected).
onboarding.topic.chat.title: Chat with other players
onboarding.topic.chat.body: The Team Chat widget lets you exchange in real time with the other Tamers of the realm.
onboarding.topic.seasons.title: Rotating seasons & climate
onboarding.topic.seasons.body: Spring, summer, autumn and winter follow one another, influencing weather, mood and Synk's stats (force, fatigue…).
onboarding.topic.dlc.title: New adventures to come
onboarding.topic.dlc.body: Once Zorghon is defeated, new stories, quests, worlds and items (expansions/DLC) will extend the adventure.
onboarding.step3.title: The Tamer's toolkit
onboarding.step3.intro: A quick tour of the features and widgets to help you day to day.
onboarding.topic.feeding.title: Feeding Synk
onboarding.topic.feeding.body: Feed Synk every day, week, month and year to make him grow and keep his hunger and happiness at their best.
onboarding.topic.huts.title: Huts & rest
onboarding.topic.huts.body: Rest Synk in a hut to recover life and fatigue. If life gets too low, forced rest triggers automatically.
onboarding.topic.stats.title: Synk's statistics
onboarding.topic.stats.body: Life, Hunger, Happiness, Force, Spells, Oxygen, Fatigue and Experience: each gauge evolves with your actions and shapes Synk's survival and progression.
onboarding.topic.dice.title: Dice rolls & combat
onboarding.topic.dice.body: The Dice Roll widget handles the daily fate roll and combat. Your Force, your gear and random bonuses/penalties influence the outcome.
onboarding.topic.combat.title: Gear wear & bare-handed combat
onboarding.topic.combat.body: Every hit wears down your equipped weapon/armor a little. Without gear, Synk fights bare-handed with a penalty to the dice roll.
onboarding.topic.potions.title: Potions & Spells
onboarding.topic.potions.body: Brew or buy potions and spells to boost your stats, heal yourself, or gain temporary magical effects.
onboarding.topic.mapmonde.title: World Map & 2D Platform
onboarding.topic.mapmonde.body: The World Map (mouse-wheel zoom, right-click drag, filters by type) and the isometric 2D Platform are synced in real time to explore the realm.
onboarding.topic.waterMountain.title: Water, mountains & oxygen
onboarding.topic.waterMountain.body: At sea or at altitude, Synk's oxygen gradually decreases (the air thins in the mountains); reach a land tile in time to recover!
onboarding.topic.platform3d.title: Minecraft-style 3D Platform
onboarding.topic.platform3d.body: Synk and his whole world (NPCs, familiars, huts, trees, mountains, lakes) come to life in 3D voxels, synced with the 2D Platform and World Map. Same directional keys (keyboard, mouse, virtual pad): hold for 1.5s to start running. Trees, rocks and NPCs block the way (left-click to interact, just like in 2D). Space + ↑ facing a mountain block to jump onto it and climb — beware, falling more than 4 cubes hurts Synk, and more than 10 cubes can be fatal (auto-revive). On a water tile, Synk sinks to chest height; right-click to dive fully and explore an underwater world full of fish and sea creatures. The camera automatically snaps back behind Synk while he walks. The window can be resized up to fullscreen, and equipped weapon/shield/helmet and other gear are visible directly on the model.
onboarding.topic.bagEquip.title: Bag & Equipment
onboarding.topic.bagEquip.body: Store weapons, armor, food, potions, vehicles, treasures, saddles and familiars in your bag, then drag them onto Synk to equip them.
onboarding.topic.familiars.title: Familiars
onboarding.topic.familiars.body: Recruit familiars who accompany and assist you on your travels and in combat.
onboarding.topic.shop.title: ZeldCraft Lands Shop
onboarding.topic.shop.body: Buy or sell all kinds of items (weapons, potions, vehicles, treasures…) sorted by category in the Shop.
onboarding.topic.widgetsChatKingdom.body: Two dedicated floating windows: chat with other players, and track your progress across the 400 Kingdom Quests.
onboarding.topic.instagram.title: Horizon ZeldCraft Community
onboarding.topic.instagram.body: Join the community on Instagram to follow the latest news, seasons and events of the realm.
onboarding.topic.eth.title: Top up with ETH
onboarding.topic.eth.body: Fund your wallet with ETH (Sepolia/Mainnet) to feed Synk and buy items — or pay directly by card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay (see the "Play without a wallet" topic below).

onboarding.topic.demoFiat.title: Play without a wallet
onboarding.topic.demoFiat.body: No crypto wallet? From the home page, try the game for free with "🎟️ Demo Access" (instant anonymous or Google sign-in — immediate access) or play right away with "💳 Play without a wallet" (Google/e-mail) and top up your coins by card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
